narrative.overview: Hang Up Club is a quiet daylight notebook (stone paper, moss ink, generous margins) that holds exactly one dark object: the phone line. Everything around a call lives on the notebook. The call itself lives on The Line, a near-black AAA screen with two hardware-like circles that looks the same in light and dark themes. When you cut a scammer off, the Line breaks apart and falls away to show the notebook underneath, with the evidence written on it.
keyCharacteristics: Two worlds: the Notebook (theme-aware, light by default) and The Line (always dark, AAA).
One accent (moss) for every positive interactive signal. Red exists only for Hang Up and the scammer's ASK marker.
Senior-first scale: body 20/30, nothing below 18px, targets ≥ 56px, primary 64px, call circles 96px.
Soft rectangles for actions (14px) and true circles for call hardware. No pills.
Hairline-first depth on the notebook; tonal steps on the Line; shadows only on things that float.
Motion is near-zero in daily use. One orchestrated moment, "The Cut", when a scam call is hung up.

rules.name: The One Moss Rule
rules.body: At most one filled moss button per view, and moss covers ≤ 5% of the pixels on any notebook screen.

rules.name: The Red Means Them Rule
rules.body: Red marks only the Hang Up circle and the ASK marker. It is never decoration, never a badge, and never "wrong" on a legitimate-call miss.

rules.name: The Line Is Always Dark Rule
rules.body: The call screen uses call-* tokens in both themes.

rules.name: The Twenty Floor Rule
rules.body: Reading text is never below 20px. The 18px meta size is allowed only for labels of four words or fewer.

rules.name: The Read-It-Exactly Rule
rules.body: Numbers, codes and seconds are set in Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono. Mono is never used for decoration.

rules.name: The Flat Notebook Rule
rules.body: Nothing at rest on the notebook casts a shadow.

dos: Do keep reading text ≥ 20px and targets ≥ 56px. Measure them in e2e.
Do keep the Line dark in both themes with AAA contrast.
Do set every phone number, second and code in Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono, grouped for reading.
Do use one filled moss button per view, placed in the bottom third on phone.
Do pair every outcome with a word and an icon.
Do write callers as fictional organisations with (NXX) 555-01xx numbers.
Do keep captions on by default and make the demo readable muted.
Do let any tap finish the signature moment immediately.
donts: Don't use red for anything except the Hang Up circle and the scammer's ASK marker.
Don't set reading text below 20px or any text below 18px, and don't ship a target below 56px.
Don't add mascots, badges, trophies, XP, leaderboards or exclamation-mark praise.
Don't show red-flag hints during a call.
Don't use shadows on the Line, or on resting notebook cards.
Don't use any real bank, agency, company or person name, logo or number.
